chunks: For when My revelations were read out to you, you turned back on your heels and fled
ai.seo_question: How did the disbelievers react when the Quran was recited to them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological state of the disbelievers who, despite hearing the clear proofs (bayyināt), chose willful ignorance and turned away in arrogance. Their action of 'turning on their heels' signifies a deliberate rejection of guidance rather than mere inattention, serving as a precursor to the divine punishment mentioned in the subsequent verses.
